newsitem.title: USA: VTX Electronics files under Chapter 11.
newsitem.headline: VTX Electronics files under Chapter 11.

text.p: VTX Electronics Corp said Friday it filed a voluntary petition for reorganization under Chapter 11 of the U.S. bankruptcy code, after it could not conclude a transaction with Elcan Technologies Inc.
Al Roth, chairman and chief executive officer, said: "DIP financing will be provided by Congress Financial and T.W. Cable L.L.C. during the reorganization process."
The company was not immediately available to comment further.

Roth also said the company appointed Carl Palazzolo and Ed Goodstein to its board, filling vacancies created by the earlier resignations of Marshall Butler, Hiro Hiranandani, Ivor Jacobson, Paul Lowell and Ken Rind.
Roth also said Paul Snead resigned as an executive officer and employee of the company.
